data.description: Unlocks a door to the Secure Storage room in the Port Authority Building at Riven Tides.
data.article: The Riven Tides Secure Storage Keycard is a keycard that opens a locked door to the Secure Storage room, which is located within the Port Authority Building in the Riven Tides map. Gaining access to this room allows Raiders to find items inside. You can obtain this keycard by searching containers, especially Breachable Containers, which are found across various maps. Raiders have reported finding it most often in the Buried City map, but also in the Dam Battlegrounds map, Spaceport map, Stella Montis map, and Blue Gate map. It is also available during the Night Raid event.

arc.name: Rocketeer
arc.description: This is a formidable flying ARC, a pure engine of destruction that dominates the airspace. It poses a significant threat not just because it flies, but because of its powerful rocket attacks and devastating focus on area-of-effect (AoE) damage. This unit is designed to saturate an area, turning cover into a liability and forcing Raiders to constantly relocate or be wiped out by the sheer force of its explosions. Treat it like a mobile artillery piece—it hits hard and wide.

data.name: Rubber Duck
data.description: Always there to lend an ear, should you need it.
data.article: The Rubber Duck is a common trinket that offers both a way to personalize your personal space and a practical use during your raids. You can collect these ducks and place them in your stash to decorate your Raider Den, making your base feel more like home. In the field, you can throw it to create a sound, effectively distracting nearby ARCs. This can be a useful tactic to draw attention away from your position or to lure them into a more favorable engagement area. You can find these trinkets inside chimneys when the Bird City event is active.

data.name: Rusted Gear
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article:
Rusted Gear is a rare resource in ARC Raiders used for Gunsmith upgrade. Rusted Gears spawn primarily inside vehicles with intact hoods and industrial containers across all maps.

Best Rusted Gear Farming Locations:

  • Dam Battlegrounds — The Controlled Access Zone currently has the highest Rusted Gear spawn rate in the game. Also check the buses and cars next to northern extract and service trucks in the Scrapyard.

  • Blue Gate — Checkpoint and Underground garage beneath the warehouse packed with searchable vehicles.

  • Spaceport — Focus on rocket assembly and vehicle maintenance areas.

  • Stella Montis — Green breachable containers in the Loading Bay.

Tips to Maximize Rusted Gear Drops: Prioritize zones tagged "Industrial" on the map. Breach vehicles with closed hoods. Run night raids for higher spawn rates and better loot quality.
